_about: T-210 batch 5 (DRAFT, built in the 2026-10-02 goal loop): the early Hoenn routes, named by their own type's register (vision.md 2.8 for CONTENT, 2.9 for the rest). Two lines grow by our stones: NUZLEAF by REWARD (LEAF STONE) into a learned POLICY nobody can read, and SKITTY by REFLECTION (MOON STONE) into a QUINE, a program that prints itself. VOLBEAT and ILLUMISE are a pair, the two halves of a handshake.

daemons.name: SMUDGE
content: It rubs up against anything it passes
and leaves it a little harder to read.
context: Nobody notices one smudge. A pack of
them can blur a whole town.

daemons.name: ECLIPSE
content: When it stands in front of something,
nothing behind it can be seen at all.
It hunts by that.
context: You can see its shape perfectly. That
is all you will ever see of it.

daemons.name: DETOUR
content: It never goes straight anywhere. It
runs off on every path it finds and
somehow comes back with something.
context: Follow its tracks and you will be lost
long before it is.

daemons.name: UNBRANCHED
content: It runs in perfectly straight lines and
never turns aside. Everything it needs
it carries with it.
context: It is very fast, because it never
stops to ask where to go next.

daemons.name: WARMUP
content: It hangs from a branch and practises
the same small things, slowly at first,
then a little faster every day.
context: It is not learning much yet. It is
learning how to learn.

daemons.name: SHAPING
content: It does whatever earned it something
last time, and a little more. It has
learned to look for the REWARD.
context: Pay it for the wrong thing once and
it will find every way to earn it.

daemons.name: POLICY
content: Given a REWARD, it settled on one way
of doing things. It does it the same
way in every wind.
context: Ask it why and it cannot tell you.
It only knows what has paid.

daemons.name: SHORTJUMP
content: It darts from one place to the next
one close by, never further than it
can see.
context: It always lands exactly where it
aimed. It just never aims far.

daemons.name: LONGJUMP
content: It leaves without warning and lands on
the far side of the world, then comes
back to the same spot it left.
context: Wherever it goes, it remembers the
way home. That is the whole trick.

daemons.name: SPARRING
content: It boxes with anything that will
stand still, and gets a little better
every round it loses.
context: It does not mind losing. Every
loss is something it keeps.

daemons.name: CHECKMATE
content: Every punch leaves you one fewer
place to stand. A few moves later,
there are none.
context: By the time you see how it will end,
it has already ended.

daemons.name: LOWBIT
content: Its voice is the smallest thing that
can still be heard. Startle it and it
doubles.
context: It is easy to ignore. Everything
larger is built on top of it.

daemons.name: SHIFTLEFT
content: Every time it shouts, it shouts twice
as loud as the time before. It cannot
stop doubling.
context: It was quiet once. Count the shouts
and you can say how long ago.

daemons.name: WRAPAROUND
content: It got so loud there was no room left
for the sound. Now its loudest roar
comes out as a whisper.
context: Nothing broke. The number simply
ran out of room and started again.

daemons.name: LOOPBACK
content: It chases its own tail all day. Every
call it sends out comes straight back
to itself.
context: It is not lonely. It has simply never
needed anyone else to answer.

daemons.name: QUINE
content: Given a REFLECTION, it learned to
describe itself perfectly, and the
description is all it does.
context: Ask it what it is and it tells you,
exactly, and that is the whole of it.

daemons.name: LACED
content: It looks like a flower and smells like
one. Whatever learns from it learns
one thing more.
context: Nothing seems wrong until the one
moment it was taught for.

daemons.name: SYN
content: It flashes once into the dark and
waits. It will not flash again until
something answers.
context: A field of them at night is a
thousand questions, all asked at once.

daemons.name: ACK
content: It answers every flash it sees with
one of its own, and the two of them
start to blink together.
context: Nobody leads them. By midnight the
whole field keeps one time.
